scope: R35 source cleanup before native execution grant issuance

environment.node_reports: synthetic client input to actual authenticated application routes

implementation: Root-only cleanup RPC revokes setup capability and drains admitted work before cloud cleanup; no native execution grant is needed
Source cleanup remains bound to the original durable queue intent, task, account revision, standard label and native ownership marker
The existing cloud provider reconciliation and MachineCandidateCleanupClient perform exact reads and deletes under the original account lock
A missing create receipt is reconciled read-only; recovered identity is kept in the cleanup journal without rewriting task/bootstrap history
An empty inventory does not prove absence after an uncertain create
Delete intent is persisted and read back immediately before dispatch; an uncertain previous delete is never repeated
Exact absence needs two reads separated by at least ten seconds; read errors and interrupted reads invalidate the previous consecutive proof
Cleanup has a separate RPC ledger and cannot clear an uncertain advance ledger or permit another create
Per-role cleanup continues after the other role fails, without replacing the initiating first error
additional_unit_checks: Partial A-only initialization can be cleaned while B was never queued
Undispatched tasks require no provider call; missing task after queue intent stays unresolved
Lost create reply uses exact provider reconciliation without a second POST or a task rewrite
Empty inventory, changed scope and unconfirmed journals cannot authorize deletion
Repeated delete and interrupted absence-read recovery remain fail-closed
Strict SSH setup binding permits cleanup after uncertain advance without erasing its ledger or first error
limitations_and_remaining_gates: This is not completed R35 whole-round acceptance or a live cloud run
Partial source states and lost create receipt recovery passed unit tests, not this full-application two-registered-source scenario
Cleanup runs the actual controller RPC handler inside a fixture that mocks provider HTTP; actual SSH transport and the outer cleanup CLI subprocess are not composed end to end yet
A process crash precisely between provider mutation and RPC reply remains to be injected; the current lost DELETE response is a mocked transport exception
The concrete installation, private import, source, DNS and native authority ports still need whole-round entry composition
Control DNS/TLS must precede source callbacks, with edge DNS initialized after source identity registration
Native execution grant issuance, real elapsed authority expiry, A1 cleanup/cooldown/A2 retry and B isolation still need assembled full-application tests
No real node binary or source installation script ran here; final unarmed LF runtime freeze still needs real node and dependency provenance
Future live scope, fresh read-only preflight and cleanup approval are separate from this isolated test
